suite.doc: Yahoo create account - positive tests. Valid data is only typed in, never submitted with Next. Test data comes from yahoo_test_data.py and is passed to the keywords as arguments.

UI tests of the Yahoo "Create account" page (https://login.yahoo.com/account/create). Only the on-screen validation is tested: no test completes (or tries to bypass) the registration. Page Object = Process_keyword/yahoo_create_account_page.resource, locators = Locator/yahoo_locators.resource.
